## Journal entry → Obsidian daily note

Receives an entry as JSON (`id`, `title`, `text`, `createdAt`) and appends it to the daily note of the day it was written.

**Setup**
1. Mount your vault into n8n, e.g. `/files/vault`.
2. Set `DAILY_NOTES_DIR` and `HEADING` in **Prepare entry**.
3. Create a Header Auth credential (`Authorization` / `Bearer <your token>`) and select it in **Entry webhook**.
4. Activate, then add the production URL and the token as a text endpoint in the app.

Sending the same entry twice does not add it twice.
